prompt: Build a 4-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 4 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = sum over weighted edges of w_ij * Z_i * Z_j. Graph: edge (0,1) weight 0.3, edge (1,2) weight 0.7, edge (2,3) weight -0.5, edge (0,3) weight 0.4. gamma = 0.45 — the SAME target as the standard ising_weighted_maxcut_4q task. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H directly — decompose it into this gate set. Any correct implementation of the phase term within this gate set is accepted. No measurement.
